source_of_truth: GitHub repository state plus authoritative documents listed below

definition_of_done.product_reality: follow docs/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT_POLICY.md and docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md: Unreal Product Reality is pre-merge when those governing docs require it; parallel-safe exceptions apply only when every documented condition is satisfied

verification.rule: never convert missing human evidence into PASS; keep implementation status separate from Product Reality acceptance

executable_lanes.evidence: Deterministic production simulation covers current mining/storage/manipulator/damage/save-load state through the canonical simulation suite

active_work_sources: open issues with active implementation evidence
work_ownership.rule: do not duplicate or compete with active work; prefer finishing existing work

regression_memory.rule: record significant or recurring reproduced failures with root cause, fix, verification, regression protection, and residual risk

readiness_scoring.rule: report unknown when evidence is insufficient

continuation: derive from current roadmap/issues with earliest incomplete vertical-slice acceptance first

portfolio_aggregation.rule: aggregate only verified repository evidence; never infer missing component state

golden_scenarios.rule: engine-independent deterministic scenario is automated; Unreal compile/playtest remains separately tracked Product Reality according to governing policy
